key: AMARIA: It looks so much bigger on the inside...
en: AMARIA: It looks so much bigger on the inside...
ja: アマリア: 中はずいぶん広く見えるね……

key: FLORINIA: Internal perspectivity often observes such an effect.
en: FLORINIA: Internal perspectivity often observes such an effect.
ja: フロリニア: 内部の遠近感覚が、しばしばそのような効果を生じさせるのである。

key: AMARIA: Yep! Whatever that means, but, yep!
en: AMARIA: Yep! Whatever that means, but, yep!
ja: アマリア: そうだね! よくわかんないけど、まあそうだね!

key: I guess we'll have to split up. I'll take this way, you guys go the other. Be careful~
en: I guess we'll have to split up. I'll take this way, you guys go the other. Be careful~
ja: 分かれた方がよさそうだね。あたしはこっちに行くから、みんなはあっちお願い。気をつけてね～

key: FLORINIA: ...Very well.
en: FLORINIA: ...Very well.
ja: フロリニア: ……よろしい。

key: FLORINIA: A secondary bisection presents itself. I'll attend to this course. Farewell.
en: FLORINIA: A secondary bisection presents itself. I'll attend to this course. Farewell.
ja: フロリニア: 第二の分岐点が現れた。この道は私が担当する。さらばだ。

key: Eh? What are you doing here?
en: Eh? What are you doing here?
ja: は? こんな所で何してんだよ?

key: You don't know what's good for you...
en: You don't know what's good for you...
ja: 自分の身のためにならないってこと、わかってねえのか……

key: Watch your step...
en: Watch your step...
ja: 足元に気をつけろよ……

key: And you've made it this far? Your friends weren't so lucky...
en: And you've made it this far? Your friends weren't so lucky...
ja: こんな所まで来たのか? お前の仲間は運が悪かったみたいだけどな……

key: Ahaha... Adorable, really.
en: Ahaha... Adorable, really.
ja: アハハ……ほんと、可愛いこと。

key: Well, go on~ We have nothing to fear.
en: Well, go on~ We have nothing to fear.
ja: さあ、来なさいよ～ 別に怖くなんてないんだから。

key: ???: Oh, Tangrowth... You're working so hard... And look at the beautiful forest you've made!
en: ???: Oh, Tangrowth... You're working so hard... And look at the beautiful forest you've made!
ja: ???: ああ、モジャンボ……頑張ってるのね……見て、こんなに美しい森を作ったのよ!

key: I know you're hurting, but if you stop now, all our hard work will go to waste...
en: I know you're hurting, but if you stop now, all our hard work will go to waste...
ja: 辛いのはわかってる。でも、ここで止めたら、今までの頑張りが全部無駄になっちゃう……

key: ???: Oh, hello... Um, my name is Lumi-
en: ???: Oh, hello... Um, my name is Lumi-
ja: ???: あ、こんにちは……えっと、わたしの名前はルミ――

key: ???: Only three of you entered? We expected more.
en: ???: Only three of you entered? We expected more.
ja: ???: 入ってきたのは三人だけ? もっと来ると思ってたのに。

key: Three are easy to deal with.
en: Three are easy to deal with.
ja: 三人くらいなら、簡単に片付けられるわね。

key: ???: Bind the first in vines...
en: ???: Bind the first in vines...
ja: ???: 一人目はツルで縛って……

key: Hang the second by her neck...
en: Hang the second by her neck...
ja: 二人目は首からつるして……

key: Let the third go on and then capture them ourselves.
en: Let the third go on and then capture them ourselves.
ja: 三人目は先に行かせて、自分たちの手で捕まえましょう。

key: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduce ourselves... I'm-
en: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduce ourselves... I'm-
ja: ???: あの、自己紹介した方が礼儀にかなうと思うんだけど……わたしは――

key: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi... Needlessly, at that! I, however, am Zero.
en: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi...  Needlessly, at that! I, however, am Zero.
ja: ???: もう自己紹介は済んだだろ、ルミ……しかも無駄にな! だが私は、ゼロだ。

key: ???: I am Eve. Collectively we are referred to as ZEL.
en: ???: I am Eve. Collectively we are referred to as ZEL.
ja: ???: わたしはイヴ。合わせて、ZELと呼ばれているわ。

key: Zel: And we're not gonna let you touch the PULSE!
en: Zel: And we're not gonna let you touch the PULSE!
ja: ゼル: PULSEには指一本触れさせないぞ!

key: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right...?
en: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right...?
ja: ゼル: でも、それが目当てで来たんでしょ……?

key: After all, all of the growth here is a result of this machine...
en: After all, all of the growth here is a result of this machine...
ja: だって、ここの成長は全部この機械のおかげなんだから……

key: Eve even built it all by herself!
en: Eve even built it all by herself!
ja: イヴが一人で全部作り上げたのよ!

key: zEl: Correct. The Link System is a simple hybridization-amplification mechanic.
en: zEl: Correct. The Link System is a simple hybridization-amplification mechanic.
ja: ゼル: その通り。リンクシステムは、単純な融合・増幅機構である。

key: Zel: So with that machine behind it, it can manipulate even the smallest root into a massive arbor wrecking ball!
en: Zel: So with that machine behind it, it can manipulate even the smallest root into a massive arbor wrecking ball!
ja: ゼル: この機械があれば、どんな小さな根っこでも、巨大な樹木の破壊球に変えられるんだ!

key: Think you can stop it? Just try!
en: Think you can stop it? Just try!
ja: 止められると思うか? やれるもんならやってみろ!

key: ...This is why you shouldn't talk so much, Lumi!
en: ...This is why you shouldn't talk so much, Lumi!
ja: ……だから　しゃべりすぎるなって言ったんだ、ルミ!

key: zEl: Zero, next time, rather than showing off the mission's keystone, let's fight with our own Pokémon.
en: zEl: Zero, next time, rather than showing off the mission's keystone, let's fight with our own Pokémon.
ja: ゼル: ゼロ、次からは任務の要を見せびらかすんじゃなくて、自分たちのポケモンで戦うべきだな。

key: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened...
en: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened...
ja: ゼル: ごめんね、モジャンボ……もっと早く止めるべきだったわ……

key: Zel: Stop yelling at me! You said this machine was supposed to make it stronger!
en: Zel: Stop yelling at me! You said this machine was supposed to make it stronger!
ja: ゼル: 怒鳴るのはやめろ! この機械は強くするためのものだって言ったのはお前だろ!

key: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor. Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress...
en: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor.  Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress...
ja: ゼル: 判断ミスの原因はお前にある。とはいえ、モジャンボが行動不能になった以上、悪性の成長は今後後退するだろう……

key: zeL: So... it's all going to go back to normal...?
en: zeL: So... it's all going to go back to normal...?
ja: ゼル: それじゃ……全部、元に戻るってこと……?

key: zEl: Correct. So there's no longer any purpose to remaining here. Recover the model, and escape at once.
en: zEl: Correct. So there's no longer any purpose to remaining here. Recover the model, and escape at once.
ja: ゼル: その通り。ならばここに残る意味はもうない。モデルを回収し、直ちに撤退せよ。

key: Zel: Hey, \PN, right? ...Don't think this is over.
en: Zel: Hey, \PN, right? ...Don't think this is over.
ja: ゼル: おい、\PNだったな? ……これで終わりだと思うなよ。

key: An egg seems to have been abandoned in the park...
en: An egg seems to have been abandoned in the park...
ja: 公園に、たまごが置き去りにされているようだ……

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 受け取りますか?

key: \PN got the egg!
en: \PN got the egg!
ja: \PNはたまごを手に入れた!

key: There was no room to take the egg...
en: There was no room to take the egg...
ja: たまごを持つ空きがなかった……

key: AMARIA: ...Ah! I can breathe!
en: AMARIA: ...Ah! I can breathe!
ja: アマリア: ……はぁ! やっと息ができる!

key: Those vines grabbed us as soon as we got close...
en: Those vines grabbed us as soon as we got close...
ja: 近づいた瞬間、あのツルに捕まっちゃって……

key: They were choking me the whole time. I'm sorry I wasn't much help.
en: They were choking me the whole time. I'm sorry I wasn't much help.
ja: ずっと首を絞められてたの。あんまり役に立てなくてごめんね。

key: But you cleared the whole thing yourself, \PN? I'm impressed!
en: But you cleared the whole thing yourself, \PN? I'm impressed!
ja: でも\PN、一人で全部片付けちゃったの? すごいじゃない!

key: FLORINIA: Presumably that person, if they can be referred to as a single subject, was an operator of Team Meteor.
en: FLORINIA: Presumably that person, if they can be referred to as a single subject, was an operator of Team Meteor.
ja: フロリニア: 推測するに、あの者――単一の主体として呼べるのであれば――はメテオ団の工作員であった。

key: I project that our observances do not compose the entirety of their assault.
en: I project that our observances do not compose the entirety of their assault.
ja: 我々の観測が、彼らの攻勢の全容を構成しているとは考えにくい。

key: AMARIA: I think so too! A lot of bad things have been happening lately.
en: AMARIA: I think so too! A lot of bad things have been happening lately.
ja: アマリア: あたしもそう思う! 最近、悪いことばっかり起きてるもんね。

key: Between the Jasper and Beryl Wards, Azurine Lake, Grandview Station and now this...
en: Between the Jasper and Beryl Wards, Azurine Lake, Grandview Station and now this...
ja: ジャスパー区とベリル区の間や、アズリン湖、グランドビュー駅、それに今回もそう……

key: Team Meteor might be a bigger threat than any of us had imagined.
en: Team Meteor might be a bigger threat than any of us had imagined.
ja: メテオ団は、あたしたちが思ってたよりずっと大きな脅威なのかもしれない。

key: I'm going to go report this to Ame, and hopefully we'll figure out what to do.
en: I'm going to go report this to Ame, and hopefully we'll figure out what to do.
ja: これはアメに報告しに行くね。何とか対策を考えられるといいけど。

key: Thanks so much for your help, \PN! We couldn't have done it without you! Bye, Rini!
en: Thanks so much for your help, \PN! We couldn't have done it without you! Bye, Rini!
ja: \PN、本当に助かったよ! あなたがいなかったら無理だった! じゃあね、リニ!

key: FLORINIA: Very well. The immediate crisis is resolved.
en: FLORINIA: Very well. The immediate crisis is resolved.
ja: フロリニア: よろしい。当面の危機は解決した。

key: I will be returning to my Gym in the Onyx Ward.
en: I will be returning to my Gym in the Onyx Ward.
ja: 私はオニキス区のジムへ戻るとしよう。

key: \PN, your attendance will be expected at your leisure.
en: \PN, your attendance will be expected at your leisure.
ja: \PN、都合の良いときに来訪することを期待する。

key: Farewell.
en: Farewell.
ja: さらばだ。

key: ???: I TOLD you they would get here too soon! If you had made this machine go faster...
en: ???: I TOLD you they would get here too soon! If you had made this machine go faster...
ja: ???: 早く着きすぎるって言ったでしょ! この機械をもっと速く動かしてたら……

key: ???: No! Tangrowth wouldn't be able to take anymore!
en: ???: No! Tangrowth wouldn't be able to take anymore!
ja: ???: だめだ! モジャンボがこれ以上耐えられない!

key: ???: The speed has already been optimized. Be glad the Pokémon was able to capture those two girls.
en: ???: The speed has already been optimized. Be glad the Pokémon was able to capture those two girls.
ja: ???: 速度はすでに最適化されている。あのポケモンが二人の女を捕らえられただけ、よしとすべきだ。

key: ???: You're really strong to be able to do everything so well, Tangrowth!
en: ???: You're really strong to be able to do everything so well, Tangrowth!
ja: ???: こんなに何でもうまくやれるなんて、モジャンボは本当に強いね!

key: ???: Hey! How much longer are we gonna ignore the other problem?
en: ???: Hey! How much longer are we gonna ignore the other problem?
ja: ???: おい! もう一つの問題、いつまで放っておくつもりだ?

key: ???: Oh, hello. Um, my name is Lumi--
en: ???: Oh, hello. Um, my name is Lumi--
ja: ???: あ、こんにちは。えっと、わたしの名前はルミ――

key: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduced ourselves. I'm--
en: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduced ourselves. I'm--
ja: ???: あの、自己紹介した方が礼儀にかなうと思う。わたしは――

key: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi. Needlessly, at that! I, however, am Zero.
en: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi. Needlessly, at that! I, however, am Zero.
ja: ???: もう自己紹介は済んだだろ、ルミ。しかも無駄にな! だが私は、ゼロだ。

key: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right?
en: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right?
ja: ゼル: でも、それが目当てで来たんでしょ?

key: All of the growth here is a result of this machine.
en: All of the growth here is a result of this machine.
ja: ここの成長は全部この機械のおかげなの。

key: And Eve built it all by herself!
en: And Eve built it all by herself!
ja: イヴが一人で全部作り上げたのよ!

key: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened.
en: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened.
ja: ゼル: ごめんね、モジャンボ……もっと早く止めるべきだったわ。

key: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor. Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress.
en: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor.  Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress.
ja: ゼル: 判断ミスの原因はお前にある。とはいえ、モジャンボが行動不能になった以上、悪性の成長は今後後退するだろう。

key: zeL: So it's all going to go back to normal?
en: zeL: So it's all going to go back to normal?
ja: ゼル: それじゃ、全部元に戻るの?

key: Zel: Hey, \PN, right?
en: Zel: Hey, \PN, right?
ja: ゼル: おい、\PNだったな?

key: Don't think this is over.
en: Don't think this is over.
ja: これで終わりだと思うなよ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
